method: Decode the approved source frame by ordinal with FFmpeg, paint the unchanged scene.ts in @napi-rs/canvas at frame/60, and compare RGB pixels against a saved native-browser Download still at the same source timestamp. Mean absolute difference is the average of absolute 8-bit RGB channel differences; values are not perceptual scores.
fontParity: The approved SpaceGrotesk.ttf is variable. Native Skia registers its default 300-weight face, so the renderer sets Canvas2D fontVariationSettings to wght 700 to match the browser's CSS 700. On the portrait 74.05s lyric region, mean per-channel error fell from 17.567 to 4.377 after this correction.
limits: These three stills establish sampled visual parity, not every-frame or acoustic synchronization accuracy.
Browser video decoding, native canvas rasterization, PNG writing, and color management can differ slightly even when scene geometry and source frame agree.
The original source media and native diagnostic stills are local inputs outside the public repository; hashes and renderer commands permit recreation when the locked source is available.
